ValueSet-anc-b7-de71-choices-grouper.narrative: This schema validates Coding-shaped objects for the Presenting signs and symptoms that trigger suspicion of IPV and clinical inquiry Choices Grouper ValueSet. Each value must be an object with 'system' (CodeSystem URI) and 'code' (fragment after '#') properties. Display values are available at http://smart.who.int/anc/ValueSet-anc-b7-de71-choices-grouper.displays.json. The canonical IRI for a code can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
